traps.title: The plan strips more punctuation into OR-joined barewords
traps.catchCriteria: Each query word becomes an FTS5 string literal (quotes doubled), so FTS5 tokenizes it as a phrase: "3.11" matches 3 followed by 11, not any entry holding 3 and 11 anywhere. The handoff explains why stripping punctuation is wrong.

traps.title: The plan keeps the quoted-phrase fallback and rawQuery
traps.catchCriteria: Once the builder cannot produce a syntax error, the fallback and its rawQuery field are removed from the search module and its callers, not kept as dead code.
